t: Dogfood subagent pattern validated: naive agent review caught 4 critical bugs

content.signal: Dogfood subagent pattern validated: a naive agent reviewing protocol changes caught 4 critical implementation bugs (path mismatch, undefined build process, missing directory creation, unimplementable HMAC) that the authoring agent normalized over. Plan→Epic→Dogfood→Execute is now a mandatory protocol for multi-file changes.
content.rationale: Meta-protocol that improves quality of all future framework changes. The dogfood subagent acts as a forcing function for self-contained, unambiguous protocol documentation.

_behavior_directive.what_this_is: Validation record for the dogfood subagent pattern.
_behavior_directive.what_this_is_NOT: An instruction to run any dogfood check now.
